progress.tip.menu: Super + Space opens the Omarchy menu for apps, settings, and more
progress.tip.keybindings: Super + K shows all the key bindings
progress.tip.superKey: Super is the Windows or command key on your keyboard
progress.tip.localSend: Share files with phones and laptops using LocalSend
progress.tip.webApps: Turn any website into an app with Install > Web App in the menu
progress.tip.terminal: Super + Return opens a terminal, Super + Shift + Return the browser
progress.tip.presentations: Turn a Markdown file into a presentation with Hype
progress.tip.webcam: Record yourself on your webcam with Monologue
progress.tip.ocr: Super + Ctrl + Print grabs text off the screen with OCR
progress.tip.screenshots: Print takes a screenshot, Alt + Print records the screen
progress.tip.reminders: Set a reminder with Super + Ctrl + R
progress.tip.themes: Switch themes from Appearance > Theme in the Omarchy menu
progress.tip.barBackground: Double-click the menu bar to make it clear, glassy, or opaque
progress.tip.desktop: Double-click the desktop to pick a new background
progress.tip.windows: Run a full Windows VM via Install > Windows in the menu
progress.tip.clipboard: Super + Ctrl + V opens the clipboard manager
progress.tip.workspaces: Super + 1 through 0 switches workspaces, add Shift to bring the window
progress.tip.colorPicker: Super + Print picks a color from anywhere on screen
progress.tip.update: Keep the system fresh with Update in the Omarchy menu
finish.title: Installed Omarchy
failure.title: Omarchy installation stopped
failure.menu: What would you like to do?
failure.noUploader: No log uploader is available in this environment.
